answer: Copying becomes a race the copycat always loses, and producing 80 original texts is the only way to fill 52 aliases; the relic log preserves both halves. The reveal must open the same plume hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the glacier gate. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
